issues.span: If they hold an idea of a person
issues.evidence: 'even if they engage in a perception up to that of a person' - the sutra runs the list of ideas through to 'person'; 'even' and 'up to' are lost, and the 'because' link to the previous line.
issues.fix: Even if they hold any of these ideas, right up to the idea of a person, they are not called an awakening hero.

issues.span: truly entering the awakening hero's vehicle
issues.evidence: 'having correctly entered the bodhisattva vehicle'; the same phrase is rendered 'correctly entered' in 8-80 and 8-84.
issues.fix: there is no thing at all called 'correctly entering the awakening hero's vehicle'.

issues.span: got any thing from the Thus-Gone One Dipankara to become fully awake
issues.evidence: 'any phenomenon by which the Tathagata fully awakened ... from Dipankara' - a thing by which he awakened, not a thing he received or got.
issues.fix: Is there any thing by which the Thus-Gone One became fully awake to the highest, complete awakening in the time of the Thus-Gone One Dipankara?

issues.span: did not get any thing at all from the Thus-Gone One Dipankara
issues.evidence: 'no phenomenon whatsoever by which the Tathagata fully awakened ... from Dipankara' - not a thing that was got.
issues.fix: there is no thing at all by which the Thus-Gone One became fully awake to the highest, complete awakening in the time of the Thus-Gone One Dipankara.
